f1.why: Logo arches and wordmark appear in canary on the binding red, not the logo's grey and blue; the brief says the mark is never redrawn

f2.why: Line spacing varies by block: the article title sits loose on desktop but tight on phone, the quote's lines are a full rule apart and the table sits off the rules

f3.why: A soft shadow on a stand-in print is taste and does not make it read as clickable; the print styling also leaves with the image round

f4.why: The handwritten address is static (p7) but uses the red that marks the PDF link, so visitors will expect it to open an email
